main.description: Pushes the requesting user's mute list to the AppView, so it takes effect immediately instead of waiting for a sync notification. The client writes the underlying records to its own personal space first, then calls this. This replaces the AppView's whole copy of the user's mute list.

preferences.description: The requesting user's settings, after the update.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: The request has no valid service auth.
